AngleId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

AnimationCurve.description:
Validated, strictly time-ordered document data; evaluation lives in
kronello-animation. Unknown meaning versions can be retained and serialized,
but cannot be edited or evaluated as version 1. Empty curves are editable;
evaluating one is an explicit error, never an implicit default value.

AnimatorMode.description:
Per-animation-unit value distribution. `step` applies the evaluated value
unchanged, `ramp` blends linearly over the selected units in reading order,
`follow` keeps the first selected unit at full effect and trails later units
by `follow_smoothing`, and `random` draws a stable seeded factor per unit.

AssetId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

AssetThumbnailRequest.description:
FLOW-002 fixed-snapshot thumbnail (ADR-0129). The decoded source frame is
addressed by an exact rational time and scaled with the deterministic
integer `scale_rgba8` path — no clock, GPU or random input participates.
The pixels are transport data only; caches live in the caller, never in
the document.

max_size.description: Longest edge of the output thumbnail in pixels (16..=1024).

time.description:
Source presentation time for video; absent decodes the origin frame.
Ignored for still images.

pts.description: Source frame timestamp actually covered by the decoded video frame.

rgba.description: Straight opaque RGBA8, row-major `width * height * 4` bytes.

bands.description: Inclusive low / exclusive high frequencies, in Hz.

time_map.description: Consumer-local time maps to the absolute analysed sample grid.

beat.description: Thresholded onset with a fixed 100 ms refractory interval, not tempo inference.

onset.description: Positive RMS difference from the preceding analysis window.

oneOf.description: Canonical fixed Project snapshot hash, target id and evaluator version.

AudioLoudnessInput.description:
AUDIO-008 measurement target. Clip and Sequence render the shared
DocumentAudioPlan; Asset decodes the verified stream directly.

oneOf.description: One clip on an audio track, measured through its authored chain.
Whole sequence extent or an explicit range within it.
A verified asset stream, optionally limited to a source range.

AudioRetimePolicy.description: NLE-001 never performs implicit pitch/speed conversion.

AvExportOutputReport.description:
Per-leg result of a multi-output delivery (ADR-0133): each output carries
its own probe, transfer report and warnings. `chapters` lists the markers
actually written into the container.

output.description: Destination as declared in the request leg.

audio.description: Primary leg audio report; absent for video-only deliveries.

outputs.description: MEDIA-004: one entry per leg in request order, primary first.

video.description: Primary leg transfer report; absent for audio-only deliveries.

background.description: Explicit opaque background in the fixed profile working space (HDR 1=203 nits).

chapters.description: MEDIA-004: chapter transfer policy for the primary leg.

output.description: Primary output destination; `movie_profile` comes from the snapshot.

outputs.description:
MEDIA-004 (ADR-0133): additional output legs; empty keeps the
pre-M10 single-output wire shape.

BackendSelection.description: Explicit execution choice. GPU initialization is lazy and never falls back.

oneOf.description: Strict VideoToolbox hardware decode and same-device Metal import.
First failed item marks the remaining items `skipped`.
Every item is attempted; failures are reported per item.

assets.description:
Insertion-ordered membership. The list behaves like an ordered set:
membership edits assign each asset at most once.

BinId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

BoundsStage.description: Resolution-independent bounds stage selected by a layout consumer.

bytes.description: Retained payload weight, excluding allocator overhead. Values use JSON byte size.

media.description:
Loaded FFmpeg capabilities; discovery failures return a typed error.
An explicitly supplied report avoids runtime initialization.

CaptionAnchor.description: Nine-direction anchor inside the caption safe area.

CaptionCueIds.description:
Caller-allocated stable identities for one imported cue (planned/apply
commands never allocate IDs during mutation).

CaptionDocument.description:
Versioned cue document. One `CaptionDocument` describes exactly one cue's
text, style and placement; its timeline interval lives on the caption clip.

spans.description: Ordered, nonoverlapping span overrides at grapheme boundaries.

text.description:
Cue payload text. `\n` is the only line separator and the content is
data: import decoders strip markup, and nothing here is executed.

version.description: Supported document version; this implementation accepts only 1.

CaptionFormat.description:
Import provenance of a cue document. Export always reserializes the stored
document; this metadata never drives rendering.

CaptionId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

CaptionOutline.description: Stroke drawn outside the glyph fill, in the sequence working color space.

width.description:
Visible outline ring width in design_px; zero is allowed but draws
nothing. Rendering strokes the glyph path centered at twice this width.

CaptionPlacement.description:
Nine-direction caption placement relative to the sequence safe area.
Ratios are stored exactly as rationals, never as floating point.

offset.description:
Additional offset from the anchor point, as a ratio of the sequence
extent. +x moves right, +y moves down.

safe_area_inset.description:
Inset applied to both sides of the sequence extent per axis, as a ratio
of that extent. Each component must be in `0..=1/2`.

CaptionSpan.description:
Span-level style override. Unknown attributes are rejected by strict
decoding instead of being silently dropped.

bold.description: Drawn as a synthesized stroke when no replacement span font is given.

font.description: Explicit replacement face; its bytes remain hash-locked.

italic.description:
Drawn as a synthesized oblique shear when no replacement span font is
given. Both flags are draw-time attributes of the span, not markup.

CaptionStyle.description:
Cue-wide base style. Span attributes override these values inside their
text range only.

background.description: Optional rectangle behind the laid-out cue block.

fill.description: Straight tagged color evaluated in the sequence working space.

font.description: Hash-locked face; rendering never substitutes family/system fonts.

cue_ids.description: Exactly one identity pair per parsed cue, in cue order.

style.description: Base cue style; per-cue format styling overrides individual fields.

track.description: Existing caption track, or the ID of the caption track the plan creates.

oneOf.description:
Copy chapters where the container supports them; otherwise record a
typed `CHAPTERS_DROPPED` warning on the leg report.
Explicitly drop chapter markers for this leg without warning.

CharacterAnimation.description: Logical source selection. Ranges are never glyph or line indices.

expected_text.description: Exact unnormalized source captured when the selector is authored.

follow_smoothing.description:
Scalar in [0, 1], dimensionless; required when `mode` is `follow`.
0.0 delegates to `step`; larger values trail later units more.

rotation.description: Angle per-unit rotation in degrees about the glyph anchor.

scale.description: Vec2 per-unit scale factors, dimensionless; 1.0 is neutral.

seed.description: Fixed seed for `random`; absent seeds still hash to stable factors.

enabled.description:
Authored contribution switch. Disabled clips keep their timeline
occupancy, links and metadata but are excluded from evaluation, video
compositing, audio mixing, captions and transitions. Serialized only
when off so documents written before NLE-005 roundtrip unchanged.

markers.description: Sequence-time annotations, confined to this placement's range.

masks.description:
FX-004 clip-local Bezier mask stack (ADR-0114). Masks multiply clip
alpha after content drawing and before `effects`; empty on old documents.

properties.description: Placement transform and effect parameters, evaluated in sequence time.

volume.description: Absent in M2 documents means unity. Evaluated in source-local time.

ClipAngleSwitchRequest.description:
NLE-007 (ADR-0127): repoint one clip's active multicam angle. Only the
addressed clip changes; the multicam-local source window is untouched and

angle.description: Replacement active angle of the clip's own multicam group.

ClipId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.

oneOf.description:

NLE-007 multicam clip (ADR-0127): one active angle of a

hardware.description: FFmpeg HARDWARE or HYBRID registration; device success is checked on open.

ColorComponents.description:
Straight RGB with independent alpha. Alpha defaults only at input; saved

read_only.description:
Read-only refers to the source project: render.sequence and

response_schema.description: Successful result value schema (without status/kind envelope).

Composition.description:
Editable document frame. After editing or decoding, validate the complete

input_bindings.description:

background.description: Explicit opaque background in the profile's pixel class space.

DesignExtent.description: Design units, independent of output pixels or display DPI.

EditCommand.description:
Externally tagged commands decode directly, retaining strict fields and
concrete model number decoding instead of serde's tagged Content buffer.

oneOf.description:
Commit the complete expression text as the property's expression source.
`metadata` is the editing envelope (id / semantic version / value_type /
budget); it is never re-derived from text. Only complete committed text
may be submitted — uncommitted IME-style input is never parsed or
applied, and malformed input fails planning with typed diagnostics and
preserves the previously stored expression.
Upsert one validated caption cue document.

Remove a cue document. Planning rejects a removal that would leave a
caption clip referencing a missing document.
FLOW-002 (ADR-0129): create one named bin; fails when the id exists.
Rename an existing bin; membership is untouched.
Delete one bin; asset records are untouched.
Replace one bin's membership with exactly this ordered asset set.

FLOW-003 (ADR-0130): upsert one versioned export preset. Updating a
preset in place is an upsert with the same id.
Remove one export preset; already queued jobs keep their fixed input.

Upsert one validated external asset record. COLOR-003 registers `.cube`
documents as `AssetKind::Data`; the locator stays external and the
content hash is caller-independent only through the import operation
that verifies it.

NLE-007 (ADR-0127): upsert one multicam group with resolved
`sync_offset`s. `multicam.create` computes the offsets before
planning; dropping an angle still referenced by a clip fails
whole-document validation like any other broken reference.

EditInsertRequest.description:
GUI-011 (ADR-0128): shared three-point placement input for `edit.insert`.
`source_range` is the source monitor's [in, out) window in source-local
time and `at` is the destination point (playhead or sequence in). `track`
overrides the sequence's declared `targets` selection.

at.description: Destination point where the window's start lands.

clip.description: Stable clip identity chosen by the caller; never derived at apply.

linked.description: Expand the ripple shift across reciprocal clip links.

source.description: Media source for the new clip (asset, multicam angle or composition).

source_range.description: Source window `[in, out)` in source-local time.

track.description: Destination track; absent resolves `Sequence.targets` by source kind.

EditOverwriteRequest.description:
GUI-011 (ADR-0128): same three-point input as [`EditInsertRequest`], but
the placement replaces covered content instead of rippling it.

at.description: Destination point where the window's start lands.

clip.description: Stable clip identity chosen by the caller; never derived at apply.

source.description: Media source for the new clip (asset, multicam angle or composition).

source_range.description: Source window `[in, out)` in source-local time.

split_tail.description:
Stable id for the tail clip created when the overwrite splits a
covered clip in two. Required only when a covered clip spans both
overwrite edges; unused otherwise.

track.description: Destination track; absent resolves `Sequence.targets` by source kind.

Effect.description: Unknown ids, parameters, fields and variants are retained verbatim.

oneOf.description:
AUDIO-007 parametric EQ. `bands` references a data table property
with `kind` (peak | low_shelf | high_shelf), `freq_hz`, `gain_db`
and `q` columns and 1..=AUDIO_EQ_MAX_BANDS rows.
AUDIO-007 Butterworth high-pass; `order` is 1..=AUDIO_FILTER_MAX_ORDER.
AUDIO-007 Butterworth low-pass; `order` is 1..=AUDIO_FILTER_MAX_ORDER.
AUDIO-008 stereo-linked feed-forward peak compressor.
AUDIO-008 ceiling limiter with instant attack and release.

COLOR-002 exposure: premultiplied working RGB is scaled by
2^exposure and shifted by offset; alpha is preserved (ADR-0108).
COLOR-002 levels with gamma, applied per premultiplied RGB channel.

COLOR-002 monotone-cubic RGB channel curve. The property is a data
table with scalar `x` and `y` columns, `x` strictly increasing, both
in [0,1], and at most CURVES_MAX_POINTS rows.
COLOR-002 hue/saturation/lightness in working HSL; alpha preserved.

saturation.description: Multiplier where 1.0 leaves saturation unchanged; finite scalar.

oneOf.description:
FX-005 chroma key (ADR-0115): alpha = keyed Cb/Cr matte, then edge
shrink/feather adjust the matte and `spill` suppresses the key hue.

edge_feather.description: Matte Gaussian feather sigma in design_px.

similarity.description: Cb/Cr distance that maps to full transparency; 0..=1.

oneOf.description:
FX-005 luma key (ADR-0115): working-space luminance distance drives
the alpha matte, then edge shrink/feather adjust it.

edge_feather.description: Matte Gaussian feather sigma in design_px.

key_luma.description: Straight-color luminance that becomes fully transparent; 0..=1.

tolerance.description: Luminance distance that maps to full opacity; 0..=1.

oneOf.description:
FX-006 glow (ADR-0115): straight luminance above `threshold` is
extracted, blurred by a Gaussian of sigma `radius`, and added back.

intensity.description: Additive contribution of the blurred bloom; nonnegative scalar.

oneOf.description:
FX-006 unsharp mask (ADR-0115): out = source + amount * (source -
blur(source)); the alpha channel participates and stays in [0,1].

FX-006 vignette (ADR-0115): darkens RGB toward the image corners;
alpha is preserved.

feather.description: Smoothstep width of the falloff; nonnegative scalar.

oneOf.description:
FX-006 corner pin (ADR-0115): the four corners of the incoming
surface's bounds are moved to these absolute Composition design_px
positions, in order top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.

COLOR-003 3D `.cube` LUT (ADR-0113). `lut` references an
`AssetKind::Data` asset whose content bytes parse as a normalized
`CubeLut`; the document stores the reference, never expanded bytes.
`intensity` blends identity into the sampled output on 0..=1. Alpha is
preserved and the authored stack order is honored.

AUDIO-011 (ADR-0131): hash-pinned audio plugin binding. The document
carries only identity + pin metadata — a bundle path string, format,
component id, manifest hash and version — never plugin bytes. The
binding is processed exclusively by the detached plugin worker; the
audio evaluator rejects it with `UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE`.

bundle.description: Bundle directory or module file path.

component.description: VST3 32-hex class id or AU `type:subtype:manufacturer` triplet.

parameters.description:
DataTable `{ param: Scalar, value: Scalar }` — VST3 normalized
parameter ids, AU native parameter values; ≤1024 rows.

plugin_version.description:
Recorded plugin version pin (AU hex version / VST3 class
version string; empty = unpinned).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 manifest pin (empty for built-in AUs).

oneOf.description:
TRACK-002 (ADR-0122): invert tracked camera motion. `tracking`
references a `TrackingDataAsset`; the smoothed trajectory uses a
symmetric window of `2*smoothing_radius+1` tracked samples;
`max_displacement` (design px), `max_rotation` (degrees) and
`max_crop` (unit interval of the source frame area) bound the applied
correction; `border` selects the uncovered-region policy with
`fill_color` for `fill`; `sampling` picks the resampler.

layout_constraints.description: Dynamic text bounds rules survive template input materialization.

noise_aliases.description: Fresh copied nested identities retain their original noise coordinate.

simulation_aliases.description: Copied simulation emitters retain their original event identity.

oneOf.description: An injected backend has no known resource/transfer contract.
MEDIA-004: MP3 CBR elementary deliverables (libmp3lame).
MEDIA-004: FLAC lossless elementary deliverables.

ExportBatchItem.description:
FLOW-003 `export.batch` (ADR-0130). One item per queued export; ordering is
the array order, and replay identity is the normalized submission payload.

destination.description: Output locator supplied to the preset; required when `preset` is set.

idempotency_key.description:
Submission idempotency key scoped to the project. When absent, a
deterministic `auto:<sha256>` key derives from the normalized
submission so identical items replay their original job.

preset.description:
Stored `Project.export_presets` id, resolved and converted
server-side. Requires `project` and `destination`.

project.description: Project containing the preset; required when `preset` is set.

submission.description:
Inline `render.submit`-equivalent request. Exactly one of `submission`
or `preset` must be set.

idempotency_key.description: The effective submission key (the explicit key or the derived one).

ExportBatchOutcome.description: Per-item batch disposition, in request order (ADR-0130).

oneOf.description: A new job record committed and a worker attempt spawned.
The idempotency key replayed an existing job; nothing was requeued.
Never attempted: `stop` policy after an earlier item failed.
Validation, replay conflict or spawn failure; `error` carries the code.

items.description:
Attempted strictly in array order. Output destinations must be unique
across the batch.
One result per request item, in the request order.

ExportOutput.description:
Mirror of `kronello_service::JobOutput`; the same `"format"` tag, snake_case

MEDIA-004: DNxHD/DNxHR + PCM24 in MXF.

composition.description:

required_features.description: Submission-time capability requirements, forwarded to the job request.

audio_codecs.description: All delivery audio codecs accepted by this output's closed profiles.

nodes.description: Ordered postorder tree; the last node is the root. No sharing or dead nodes.

ExpressionFormatRequest.description:
Canonical surface text for one canonical expression AST (ADR-0105). The
stored AST is formatted read-only; metadata is never derived from text.

expression.description: Format this supplied AST instead of reading a stored expression.

expression_id.description: Format this stored expression; required when `expression` is omitted.

revision.description: Snapshot revision the stored expression was read from, when retrieved.

text.description:
Canonical surface text. Reparsing it with the same editing-envelope
metadata reproduces the identical AST for every in-syntax expression.

ExpressionId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

ExpressionMetadata.description:
Editing envelope for text-applied expressions. Identity, semantic version,
declared result type and budget are never re-derived from text.

oneOf.description: Seconds in the authored source scope, after its rational time mapping.
Stable property in the authored source scope; None means composition input.
Integer row operand and statically typed column in immutable table data.

Nonnegative lookback seconds on the root timeline, quantized to 1 ns.
Static identity remains a dependency even when sampling the past.
Explicit rational offset.
Radians, explicitly dimensionless scalar input.
Quintic interpolation between adjacent fixed lattice hashes in [-1, 1].
Fixed hash noise in [-1, 1], keyed by seed, instance, element and input.

color.description: Color Property: explicitly tagged straight RGB and independent alpha.

FiniteF64.description: No non-finite value can be constructed or deserialized through the public API.

FlowFallbackPolicy.description:
TRACK-003 (ADR-0123): the explicit failure policy authored on an
optical-flow interpolation. There is no silent fallback; `blend` is the
only permitted degraded path and must be authored.

FontRef.description:
File hash plus face index fixes the actual bytes; names are verified too.
No family lookup or implicit system-font fallback is permitted.

FrameInterpolation.description:
TRACK-003 (ADR-0123): intermediate-frame synthesis mode attached to a
piecewise retime. Absence keeps the legacy nearest-frame sampling.

oneOf.description: Bidirectional flow warps the neighboring decoded frames.

block_radius.description: Half-size of the matched block; the block spans `2*r+1` pixels.

confidence_floor.description: Per-cell forward/backward consistency confidence floor in `[0, 1]`.

flow_fallback.description: Explicit degraded-mode policy; `None` rejects on low confidence.

levels.description: Pyramid levels including the base image.

search_radius.description: Half-size of the exhaustive search window at the coarsest level.

frame_index.description: Decimal absolute time-zero frame index; absent for arbitrary still time.

FrameRate.description: A positive exact number of frames per second.

transform.description: Gradient coordinates to unit coordinates; bbox mapping is applied next.

GradientSpread.description: Versioned paint settings. Missing settings preserve VEC-003 semantics.

base_revision.description: Decimal revision, independent of JSON number precision.

InspectScopesRequest.description:
COLOR-004: evaluate one fixed snapshot frame at `time` and return
deterministic integer scope bins. Bins observe the composited
working-space frame; display conversion remains a client concern.

InspectScopesResult.description:
Integer histograms for the four COLOR-004 scope families, plus the
snapshot revision and working space that produced them.

size.description: Frame size the bins were computed over, in output pixels.

kind.description:
containment_parent / transform_parent / matte / property / shape / text /
font / curve / expression. Parent graphs remain separate.

InstancePath.description:
Root-to-leaf stable placement identities. Empty denotes the root definition.
A path is contextual: resolve it from a root Composition to validate it.

audio_layout.description:
ADR-0124: omitted selects stereo; a set value is validated against
the closed layout set at parse time and pins audio envelope 3.

oneOf.description:
MEDIA-004 (ADR-0133): DNxHD/DNxHR + PCM24 in MOV. `dnx_profile`
selects the closed `dnxhd` encoder profile.
MEDIA-004: DNxHD/DNxHR + PCM24 in MXF.
MEDIA-004: deterministic two-phase indexed-color GIF (video only).
MEDIA-004: MP3 CBR elementary audio (mono/stereo layouts only).
MEDIA-004: FLAC lossless elementary audio.

serializes cue documents from the fixed snapshot; no frames render.

interpolation.description: Applies to [this key, next key). Validated even on the last key.

LayoutValue.description:
Semantic bounds supplied by the upper compiler, without backend objects or
evaluation history. None denotes no geometry at that stage, never a fallback.

LutImportRequest.description:
COLOR-003 `.cube` import request (ADR-0113). The caller-allocated asset id
names the record; the content hash is computed from file bytes here and
recorded as `content_hash`, never trusted from the request.

asset.description: Id of the `AssetKind::Data` record the import upserts.

path.description:
Local `.cube` locator; stored relative to the project directory when it
lives inside it, otherwise absolute (the relink/search convention).

LutInput.description:
COLOR-003 explicit `.cube` render input (ADR-0113): `hash` is the
lowercase hex SHA-256 of the document bytes an asset records as
`content_hash`; `path` is a local locator read, parsed and verified when
the snapshot is frozen, then carried inside the snapshot for replay.

Marker.description:
A single authored annotation in sequence time. Clip markers reference
sequence time (not clip-local source time) and stay inside the clip's
`timeline_range`.

role.description:
MEDIA-004 (ADR-0133): semantic role. `chapter` entries transfer into
chapter-capable delivery containers; absent in pre-M10 documents.

title.description:
Chapter display title written to capable containers. `comment` stays
the authoring annotation and is never transferred (ADR-0133).

MarkerColor.description: Closed set; transports never guess a color from a label.

MarkerId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

MarkerRole.description: Closed marker roles; transports never infer delivery semantics from text.

oneOf.description: Time annotation without delivery semantics.
Output chapter boundary; the marker `title` is the chapter name.

Mask.description:
One authored mask row. Every parameter is a Property reference so paths and
scalars share the existing constant/curve/expression evaluation, evaluated
in sequence time on the clip's lowered node.

closed.description:
Authored path closure. `closed` masks offset as rings; open masks offset
as open chains. Fill coverage itself always closes subpaths.

expansion.description:
Outward (positive) or inward (negative) path offset in clip-local
design_px.

feather.description: Edge blur sigma in clip-local design_px; nonnegative scalar.

invert.description: Inverts this mask's own coverage before the mode combine.

path.description: Bezier path in clip-local design_px; `ValueType::Path` property.

MaskId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

MaskMode.description:
Stack combine order is authored order; coverage composes over the clip's
accumulated alpha. `Add` unions coverage, `Subtract` removes it, `Intersect`
keeps the overlap, and `Difference` keeps the symmetric difference.

MatteBinding.description:
Explicit render inputs until a document-level matte model is implemented.
A consumed matte is removed from display roots/children, unless visible is
true. Keys use stable instance paths, never document-array positions.

visible.description: A consumed matte may also be shown in normal composition draw order.

detail.description:
The full asset record for known-version objects. Opaque assets carry
only their identity plus an `UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION` status.

MediaChapter.description:
MEDIA-004 (ADR-0133): one container chapter in output-relative master
time. `id` is informational on probes; on write the muxer assigns its own.

end.description:
Exclusive end; strictly greater than `start` at the 1/48000 master
clock granularity used across the FFI boundary.

title.description: Display title copied from the chapter marker; may be empty.

MediaNode.description: Explicit media stream; AUDIO-003 executes audio only.

time_map.description: Maps time relative to the owning node's active_range.start.

volume.description: A kronello.audio.volume Property owned by the same SceneNode.

chapters.description: MEDIA-004: container chapters in output-relative master time.

duration.description: Container-level duration; the only duration WebM publishes.

MediaProxyMode.description:
No device handles, latest-document lookup, implicit fonts, or mutable state.
The complete Project (including independent opaque data) participates in the
identity even though only the selected dependency closure is executable.
Transient render-input choice for preview proxy substitution (ADR-0119).
`Off` is the only legal mode for file-writing outputs; `Prefer` substitutes
a registered proxy for decode while keeping authored extent and identity.

oneOf.description: Always decode the authored original asset (exports and fixed jobs).

Decode the registered proxy when the link is valid, otherwise fall back
to the original at full quality. Preview-only.

MediaQueryRequest.description:
FLOW-002 project-wide media browser query (ADR-0129). Reports every asset
with the same cheap locator probe `sequence.query` uses — present files are
unverified until a hash-checked `resolve_asset` runs — plus the persisted
bin list. Ordered by document position, never by wall clock.

assets.description: Every project asset, in document order.

channel_mask.description: Native speaker-mask bits when the container records one (ADR-0124).

MediaWarning.description: A typed non-fatal delivery notice recorded on a leg report (ADR-0133).

Modifier.description:
Ordered modifier frame only, with semantic parameters and a stable identity.
No modifier algorithm or execution capability is implemented here. The
animation compiler must resolve kind/version and reject unsupported kinds.

ModifierId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

oneOf.description: Deterministic two-pass indexed-color GIF (palette LUT + Bayer dither).
MP3 CBR 256k mono/stereo elementary output.
FLAC lossless elementary output.

asset.description:
Camera media. Resolved against `Project.assets` at validation and
render time; a missing asset is a typed `SOURCE_MISSING` failure.

id.description: Stable UUID identity; never an array index or display name.

name.description: Display label; never used as identity.

stream_index.description: Visual stream inside `asset` that carries this angle's picture.

sync_offset.description:
Angle media time minus multicam-local source time, in rational seconds.
`media_time = multicam_time + sync_offset`; the sign convention is fixed
so `clip.angle_switch` changes only which stream is sampled.

asset.description: Document asset carrying this angle's media.

audio_stream_index.description:
Audio stream used for `audio` sync estimation; absent defaults to the
asset's first stream without visual dimensions.

angles.description: Angles in display order; every angle needs a stable caller id.

multicam.description: Stable multicam identity chosen by the caller.

reference.description: Reference angle for `timecode`/`audio`; defaults to the first spec.

MulticamId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

oneOf.description:
Align each angle's declared `start_time` origin with the reference's:
`sync_offset = start_time(angle) - start_time(reference)`, with absent
declarations counting as zero.

Deterministic normalized cross-correlation over the decoded 48 kHz
audio of each angle's `audio_stream_index` (or its first audio
stream). Failure to estimate yields `MULTICAM_SYNC_FAILED`.

Explicit per-angle `sync_offset` values from `offsets`; every listed
angle must be covered and extra keys are rejected.

Mutation.description:
Paths use object-member segments, avoiding ambiguous JSON pointer escaping.
An array segment selects an object by its UUID `id`, never by position.
The service replaces ordered arrays (including modifiers and draw order)
as a unit; only unordered model collections use member paths.

luts.description: COLOR-003 explicit `.cube` locators for diagnostic scene compile.

mattes.description: Explicit transient matte bindings, using the existing RenderSnapshot contract.

render_diagnostics.description: Full-composition compiler failures are distinct from this node's causes.

NodeId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

NodeKind.description: Content hooks only; geometry, text layout, and rendering are later layers.

OutputSpec.description:
MEDIA-004 (ADR-0133): one additional delivery leg of an `export.render`
job. All legs share the single render pass; each leg has its own frozen
export snapshot, staged artifact, probe verification and no-clobber
publish. Any leg failure fails the whole job.

chapters.description:
Chapter transfer policy for this leg; incapable containers produce a
typed `CHAPTERS_DROPPED` warning rather than silent loss.

destination.description:
Absolute publish destination; the extension must match the profile's
container and the path must be free at submission.

Path.description:
A document geometry container only. Topology checking/morph evaluation is
deferred to the vector/animation layer; Path currently supports Hold only.

class_id.description: VST3 class id hex; AudioUnit component triplet.

PluginFormat.description:
Host ABI family. `vst3` uses the hand-written COM-compatible loader in
`abi::vst3`; `audio_unit` uses AudioToolbox through `abi::au` (macOS).

PluginParameter.description:
One plugin parameter assignment. VST3 takes `value` as the normalized
0..=1 domain of `IEditController::setParamNormalized`; AudioUnit takes the
unit's native parameter value domain (`AudioUnitSetParameter`, Float32).

id.description: VST3 ParamID or AudioUnit parameter id.

`audio.plugin_probe`: describe the pinned plugin through the detached
helper. Plugin code runs only inside the helper; this process receives
one bounded JSON response.

deadline_ms.description: Helper watchdog budget in milliseconds (1000..=600000, default 120000).

plugin.description: Hash-pinned plugin binding; `path` must be a local filesystem locator.

classes.description: All classes the bundle exports; `component` selects among them.

name.description:
Declared plugin name (PClassInfo2 / AudioComponentCopyName), or the

PluginSpec.description:
Hash-pinned plugin binding. `path` + `sha256` pin the bundle content for
file-backed plugins; a built-in (file-less) Audio Unit is pinned by its

component.description:
VST3: 32-hex component class id (TUID bytes). AudioUnit:

(absent selects a built-in system component).

sha256.description:
Lowercase hex SHA-256 of [`bundle_manifest_hash`]; required whenever
`path` is present.

version.description:
Recorded plugin version. AudioUnit pins `AudioComponentGetVersion`
as hex (e.g. `00010600`); VST3 records the class version string for
audit when the bundle reports one.

bins.description:
FLOW-002 media organization (ADR-0129): unordered bin collection keyed
by `Bin.id`. An asset may appear in several bins.

export_presets.description:

AI-003 (ADR-0126): a media node inside a template composition reframed
from the confidence-weighted gaze of a `TrackingDataAsset`. The window is
injected as a layout-derived Vec2 pair through the shared dependency path.

node.description: Media (`Media` or `Null` slot) node inside the placement's composition.

SmartReframeSettings.description:
Versioned smart-reframe settings (ADR-0126): seed selection, temporal
smoothing window, padding, zoom cap and easing are all hash-covered.

max_zoom.description:
`>= 1`: the crop never shrinks below `1 / max_zoom` of the fitted
window (the tightest allowed crop scale).

padding.description:
Gaze margin fraction in `[0, 1]`: `0` is the tightest allowed crop,
`1` the largest target-aspect window fitting the source.

seeds.description:
Selected `TrackingDataAsset::seeds` indexes feeding the gaze centroid;
empty selects every seed in stable order.

smoothing_window.description:
Symmetric temporal smoothing radius in source seconds; zero samples
only frames exactly at the source time.

target_aspect.description: Target crop aspect ratio `width / height` in source pixels.

SourcePreviewRef.description:
Previewable document source for `RenderTarget::Source` (GUI-011,
ADR-0128). Unlike `SourceRef`, only kinds with a fixed media or
composition identity are representable — bin assets, multicam angles, and
compositions — so the value stays `Copy + Eq` like the rest of
`RenderTarget`. Generator, caption, and adjustment clips have no monitor
preview and are rejected at the conversion boundary.

oneOf.description:
FX-007 (ADR-0116): no payload; the clip applies `effects` to the
composited lower video tracks across its timeline range.

NLE-007 (ADR-0127): one active angle of a `Project.multicams` group.
The clip's local source time lives in multicam-local time; the angle's
`sync_offset` maps it to that angle's media time, so `clip.angle_switch`
re-samples the same multicam interval through another stream.

StabilizeBorder.description:
TRACK-002: how the stabilized output covers regions the inverse warp maps
outside the source frame. `Fill` paints `fill_color`; `replicate` clamps
to edge texels; `reflect` mirrors the frame at its boundary.

StabilizeSampling.description: TRACK-002: source-frame resampling for the stabilized inverse warp.

start_time.description: Absolute PTS origin. Missing legacy metadata means zero, never latest.

StreamingExportReport.description:
Logical I/O observed after successful operations. Stage byte lengths come
from file metadata; they are not physical device I/O or process RSS estimates.

options.description: Absent options retain the exact VEC-003 execution path.

StrokeOptions.description: Explicit opt-in; lengths are local design_px, offset is an evaluated Property.

fill_rule.description: Defines the interior independently of whether the shape has fill paint.

targets.description: Explicit IDs and placement, one destination for each SVG path.

TargetTracks.description:
Per-kind implicit edit destinations. A present entry must reference an
existing track of the matching kind; absent means untargeted.

bounds.description: Explicit bounds stage; omitted legacy bindings keep the layout box.

smart_reframes.description:
AI-003 (ADR-0126): tracking-driven crop windows on media nodes, one
layout-derived rule per placement through the shared dependency path.

content_hash.description: Hash of the complete reachable authoring content, fixed by define.

inputs.description: Omitted retains every existing override; incompatible inputs must be resolved explicitly.

region.description: Omitted returns semantic preview data without initializing a backend.
Omitted returns semantic preview data without initializing a backend.

definition.description: Effective variant bindings, public schemas, duration and bounds policies.

diagnostic.description: A failed preview is diagnostic data, never a render success.

TemplateVariant.description: Each aspect variant freezes a separate authored Composition and bindings.

TemporalSettings.description: Phase is an exact frame offset of the exposure start, not an angle.

line_height.description: Absolute baseline spacing in design_px, not a font-size multiplier.

path.description:
Optional `ValueType::Path` Property whose bezier guides glyph baselines.
With a path, `alignment` anchors along path arc length instead of the
wrap box; glyphs past the path end are dropped, not errors.

styles.description: Ordered, nonoverlapping, complete coverage at grapheme boundaries.

TextRange.description: Half-open UTF-8 byte range in the original, unnormalized text.

TimeBezier.description:
Normalized time/value-progress handles between (0, 0) and (1, 1).
Ordered x handles guarantee monotonic time. Finite y handles may overshoot.
These are dimensionless progress values, never stored timestamps.

interpolation.description: TRACK-003: absent keeps the legacy single-frame sample.

TimeRange.description: A half-open interval [start, end). Equal endpoints describe an empty range.

oneOf.description:
Append one authored track. Track kind is part of the value; validation
enforces per-kind clip rules.
Split strictly inside the placement, without implicit linked/transition edits.
Move one placement or its transitive reciprocal link component.

Slide the source window inside an unchanged placement. `linked` slips
the complete reciprocal component so linked audio follows video.

Move the selected placement(s) by delta while the adjacent clips on the
same tracks absorb the shift through their source handles. Every
selected run requires an adjacent clip on both sides.

Move the shared edit point after `clip`; each selected placement's
directly adjacent successor trims or extends symmetrically.

Remove one placement or its complete reciprocal link component and keep
the resulting gap. Incident transitions must be removed explicitly.

NLE-005 authored contribution switch. A disabled clip keeps its
timeline occupancy, links and metadata but renders and mixes nothing.

NLE-005 implicit edit destinations, one per track kind. `None` clears
targeting; a present entry must reference an existing matching track.

NLE-006: split `clip` at `at` and pin the right part's source time with
a piecewise hold map. The right clip identity is deterministic, the
operation requires an unlinked, transition-free forward clip, and undo
restores the original placement exactly.

Delete `range` on the listed tracks and close the gap by shifting all
later content by the range's duration. A clip straddling both range
edges is rejected; a partially covered clip trims the covered side.
`linked` expands affected clips to complete reciprocal components,
which are evaluated by their own overlap with `range` on any track.

Place `clip` at its `timeline_range.start()`, shifting every clip at or
after that point on the target track right by the clip's duration. The
typed gap-opening counterpart of `ClipOverwrite`; a clip straddling the
insertion point makes the whole operation fail. `linked` expands the
shifted set to complete reciprocal components across tracks.

Place `clip` over its `timeline_range`, replacing covered placements or
covered split segments without moving neighbours. The typed overwrite
counterpart of `ClipInsert`; transitions sharing the range conflict.
`split_tail` supplies the stable id for the new tail clip created when
a middle overwrite splits a covered clip in two; the head keeps the
covered clip's identity.

Upsert a sequence marker (`clip` absent) or a marker scoped to that
clip's timeline range. Marker times are always sequence times.

Move a marker within its owning list; recolor or recomment through
`MarkerSet` with the same marker id.

Set or clear the In/Out work area. Rendering only observes the explicit
`SequenceRenderRequest.range`; the service never reads this field.

Replace the selected clips' links with one reciprocal group. Old edges
incident to the group are removed at both endpoints.

Shift placements starting at/after pivot on explicit tracks. Reject a
clip straddling pivot. linked=true includes complete link components.

FX-004 (ADR-0114): atomically replace a clip's mask stack and the clip
properties the masks reference — the same full-list contract as
ClipSetEffects so undo/idempotency need no special casing.

NLE-007 (ADR-0127): repoint one clip's active multicam angle. Only the
addressed clip's `SourceRef::Multicam.angle` changes — the
multicam-local source window is untouched and later clips never
inherit the switch.

base_revision.description: Decimal revision, independent of JSON number precision.

id.description: New `TrackingDataAsset` id; also the `DataAssetCell` lookup key.

TrackId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

oneOf.description: Text cues rendered above every video track; never enters audio mixing.

TrackState.description:
Authored output switches plus the editing lock; `locked` defaults to off so
documents written before NLE-005 stay unlocked.

locked.description:
Editing lock: mutations that would change this track or its clips are
rejected during planning with `TRACK_LOCKED`.

homography.description:
Plane mode: row-major homography from first-frame normalized
coordinates onto this frame's normalized coordinates.

points.description: One entry per seed (points) or per corner (plane).

time.description: Exact rational source presentation time of the sampled frame.

x.description: Normalized source-space match center in `[0, 1]` on both axes.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over the versioned payload; recomputed on validation.

sample_rate.description: Nominal sample cadence of `frames` rows in source seconds^-1.

seeds.description: Seeds in stable order; plane mode stores the four corners.

oneOf.description: One or more independent template-match points.
Four tracked corners reduced to a per-frame homography.

search_radius.description: Per-frame search half extent around the previous position.

template_radius.description: Match-template half extent in source pixels.

x.description: Normalized source-space seed center in `[0, 1]` on both axes.

content_hash.description: Locked `Asset::content_hash`; mismatches mark the result stale.

bytes_estimate.description: None means not estimated, rather than zero or a measured value.

params.description:
FX-003 per-kind payload. Absent in pre-FX-003 documents and required
for all non-crossfade kinds; crossfade must not carry one (ADR-0109).

TransitionDirection.description: Closed direction set shared by the wipe and slide v1 transitions.

TransitionParams.description: FX-003 transition payloads; the variant must match Transition::kind.

oneOf.description: Continuous degrees: never reduced modulo 360.

assumptions.description: Missing tags are visible assumptions, never inferred from image pixels.

oneOf.description: No semantic hiding cause found; pixel coverage/occlusion is not measured.

VisibilityCode.description: Stable semantic causes, extensible without adding state to the inspector.

oneOf.description: A text path ended before all glyphs were placed; the rest are dropped.

error.description: Original typed failure, including expression/cycle/overflow codes.

message.description: Diagnostic text only. Clients branch on code/category/impact/details.

subject.description: The responsible node; ancestors retain their own instance identity.
